newsitem.title: USA: Stratus sees strong Q2, 97 to be good year.
newsitem.headline: Stratus sees strong Q2, 97 to be good year.

text.p: Stratus Computer Inc said it looks forward to a continued strong performance in the second quarter and said 1997 "will be a very good year."
Stratus reported a better-than-expected first quarter, with earnings of $0.62 a share, on revenues of $155.7 million. According to First Call, the consensus estimate was $0.49.
"Revenues and earnings set new first quarter records for Stratus," said Stratus Chairman and CEO Bill Foster.
Stratus said its product revenues grew at 17 percent, including 15 percent in hardware revenues and 31 percent growth in application software licensing revenues.

Stratus said that its indirect reseller channels all had significant increases in sales over last year, especially NEC Corp revenue, which grew 33 percent from fourth quarter and up 81 percent versus the year-ago period.
Stratus also said that its international distributors had another solid quarter, up 12 percent from last year.
But its direct sales were down slightly from the year ago period, with flat revenues in the U.S. and an eight percent drop in international markets.
Stratus said that sales in financial services were strong, up 38 percent, and telecommunications were up 58 percent.
